parsed.post: New personal best: 1.031230! This beat my previous best of 1.032055. It seems lowering the learning rate from 0.05 to 0.04 is a winning move. Next, I will test if we can further reduce the learning rate to 0.03 to see if the convergence continues.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 to continue the descending learning rate trend.
